meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把仓库里未关闭的问题按“共同根因”分组，每组开一个主问题并附设计文档，用固定评论关闭子问题；之后它持续将新 bug 归到对应组，并能为每组发一个修复 PR，合并后自动关掉那组问题。
howto.when: 当仓库的未关闭问题有几十个且疑似同源，而你要求对问题做分类、去重等整理，或询问某条新 bug 该归入哪个计划时，Claude 会按流程接管。

say.text: 把这些 issue 按根因分成几组，每组建主 issue 和设计文档。
say.note: 它会读完所有 issue 正文与评论后再分组。

say.text: 这条新 bug 应该归入哪个计划？按流程处理一下。
把 plan-02 的子问题打包成一个修复 PR，并补测试矩阵。
say.note: PR 合并时会自动关闭列表中的子 issue。

howto.what_en: Claude reads open issues, clusters by root cause, creates a master issue + design doc per cluster, closes child issues, keeps routing new bugs to the matching plan, and can ship one fix PR per cluster.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a repo has dozens of open issues and you ask to triage/consolidate/dedupe them, build a plan/roadmap from them, or route a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster these issues by root cause and create a master issue plus design doc per group.
say_en.note: It reads each full issue and its comments before clustering.

say_en.text: Which existing plan does this new bug belong to? Handle it.
say_en.note: It matches a master, posts a Round N comment, and closes the bug.

say_en.text: Bundle the child issues under plan-02 into one fix PR and add the test matrix.
say_en.note: The PR lists the child issues and auto-closes them on merge.
